newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality Worldwide names Parker chairman.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality Worldwide names Parker chairman.

text.p: Hospitality Worldwide Services said Thursday it named Leonard Parker chairman of the board and that Robert Berman as president and chief executive officer.
Hospitality recently purchased the Leonard Parker Co. Berman was most recently managing director of Watermark Investments Ltd.

The Company also said that chief executive officer Alan Friedberg has been appointed president of the company's new Renovation Division and Douglas Parker will become president of its new Purchasing Division.
The company said Leonard Parker, Douglas Parker and Robert Berman have also been elected directors.
